Honest scoring is the point: a studio hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: AI Actor Studios Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for AI Actor Studios: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for AI Actor Studios — studios directing synthetic actors.

Phase 1 — Prove (actor models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (studio logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (performance capture): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (likeness rights): studio hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and film-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
